name: WTI-Brent Crude Oil Spread Analysis
description: Analyzes the WTI-Brent crude oil spread (CL minus Brent). Charts the raw spread with dual-color area fill, rolling mean with Bollinger-style bands, distribution histogram, and a summary table of key current statistics including 1-year average, min, max, and z-score.
source:
# =============================================================================
# WTI-BRENT CRUDE OIL SPREAD ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Computes the daily spread: WTI (CL) minus Brent (SC).
# Outputs:
#   1. Dual-color area chart of raw spread (blue = WTI premium, red = Brent premium)
#   2. 20-day rolling mean with ±1σ and ±2σ bands (60-day window)
#   3. Summary table: current spread, 1Y avg, 1Y min, 1Y max, z-score
#   4. Histogram of spread distribution with vertical marker at current level
# =============================================================================

# --- WTI (CL) Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
wti = ffill(cl_cont.c)

# --- Brent (SC) Data via reference_futures ---
brent_raw_o, brent_raw_h, brent_raw_l, brent_raw_c, brent_raw_v, brent_raw_vw, brent_raw_n = reference_futures(ticker='SC')()
# reference_futures does not return oi and s, so we create placeholders
# Actually reference_futures outputs: o, h, l, c, v, vw, n — no oi/s
# We need to ffill the close directly since reference_futures doesn't need continuation
brent = ffill(brent_raw_c)

# --- Spread: WTI - Brent ---
spread = wti - brent

# --- Chart 1: Raw Spread with Dual-Color Area Fill ---
spread_abs = abs(spread)
spread_pos = (spread + spread_abs) / 2.0   # positive values only (WTI premium)
spread_neg = (spread - spread_abs) / 2.0   # negative values only (Brent premium)

# Replace zeros with NaN for clean area fill
spread_pos_clean = spread_pos if spread_pos > 0 else 0.0 / 0.0
spread_neg_clean = spread_neg if spread_neg < 0 else 0.0 / 0.0

bar_ts = index()

xy_lines(
    title='WTI-Brent Crude Oil Spread',
    category='1. Raw Spread',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='Spread ($/bbl): WTI minus Brent',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI Premium', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Brent Premium (WTI Discount)', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, spread_pos_clean, spread_neg_clean)

# --- Chart 2: Rolling Mean with Bollinger-Style Bands ---
spread_sma = ma(period=20)(spread)                  # 20-day rolling mean
spread_std = stddev(period=60)(spread)               # 60-day rolling std dev

upper_2 = spread_sma + 2.0 * spread_std             # +2σ
upper_1 = spread_sma + 1.0 * spread_std             # +1σ
lower_1 = spread_sma - 1.0 * spread_std             # -1σ
lower_2 = spread_sma - 2.0 * spread_std             # -2σ

xy_lines(
    title='WTI-Brent Spread: 20-Day Mean with ±1σ / ±2σ Bands (60-Day Window)',
    category='2. Spread Bands',
    y_axis_label='Spread ($/bbl)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spread', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day Mean', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='+2σ', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='+1σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='-1σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='-2σ', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, spread, spread_sma, upper_2, upper_1, lower_1, lower_2)

# --- Chart 3: Summary Table ---
# 1-Year (252 trading days) rolling statistics
spread_1y_avg = ma(period=252)(spread)
spread_1y_min = min(period=252)(spread)
spread_1y_max = max(period=252)(spread)
spread_zscore = zscore(window=252)(spread)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='WTI-Brent Spread Statistics',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        col_headers=['Current Spread', '1Y Avg Spread', '1Y Min', '1Y Max', 'Z-Score (1Y)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Spread', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='1Y Avg', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='1Y Min', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='1Y Max', grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Summary Statistics',
    order=1
)(spread, spread_1y_avg, spread_1y_min, spread_1y_max, spread_zscore)

# --- Chart 4: Histogram of Spread Distribution ---
# Get current (last) spread value for vertical reference line
# We'll use cumulative Last to get a static "current" value for the reference line
current_spread = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Last)(spread)

histogram(
    title='Distribution of Daily WTI-Brent Spread',
    category='4. Spread Distribution',
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label='Spread ($/bbl)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    order=1
)(spread)
